en.headline: SAR para paddlers claim multiple bronzes at Asian Para Games
en.dek: Hong Kong table tennis athletes secured several bronze medals on Tuesday in Nagoya, with some still in contention for higher places later in the day.
body: Hong Kong, China’s para table tennis team produced a strong showing on Tuesday at the Asian Para Games in Nagoya, Japan, collecting multiple bronze medals at Sky Hall Toyota.

With no third-place play-offs in individual events, several athletes were already assured of at least bronze before the semi-finals. Wong Yue-ching earned bronze after a 3-0 loss to China’s Wang Rui in the women’s singles Class 7 semi-final. Her teammate Chiu Kan-shan advanced to the final after defeating South Korea’s Kim Seongok 3-1 and will face Wang for gold later on Tuesday.

In the women’s singles Class 11, Wong Ting-ting also reached the final and will compete for gold against Japan’s Miya Yamaguchi. Pang Wing-ka took bronze after a straight-games loss to China’s Liu Xiaowu in the Class 6 semi-final. Lam Yan-yu secured bronze following a 3-2 defeat to Chinese Taipei’s Lin Tzu-yu in the Class 10 category.

On the men’s side, Wong Chi-yin claimed bronze after a 3-2 win over Japan’s Koyo Iwabuchi in the Class 9 semi-final, while Wong Hon-lam took bronze after falling 3-1 to China’s Zhao Yiqing. The Hong Kong Paralympic Committee said the results added to the city’s medal tally at the Games.

zh.headline: 香港殘疾人乒乓球選手名古屋亞殘運會奪多面銅牌
zh.dek: 香港乒乓球運動員周二在名古屋取得多面銅牌，部分選手仍有機會在稍後比賽爭奪更高名次。
body: 中國香港殘疾人乒乓球隊周二在日本名古屋舉行的亞洲殘疾人運動會表現出色，於豐田天空館取得多面銅牌。
個人賽不設銅牌戰，多位選手在四強前已確保至少銅牌。女子單打七級，黃予晴在四強以0比3不敵中國隊王睿，取得銅牌；隊友趙勤珊在另一場四強以3比1擊敗韓國金成玉，將在稍後與王睿爭奪金牌。
女子單打十一級，黃婷婷同樣晉身決賽，將與日本山口美彌爭金。女子單打六級，彭詠嘉在四強直落三局不敵中國劉曉武，獲得銅牌。女子單打十級，林欣如以2比3惜敗中華台北林子瑜，取得銅牌。
男子單打九級，黃志賢在四強以3比2擊敗日本岩淵耕洋奪銅；黃漢霖則在另一場四強以1比3不敵中國趙一慶，同樣獲得銅牌。香港殘疾人奧委會表示，這些成績為香港在本屆賽事的獎牌榜再添分數。
